column1: # R1656 — the measured backlog of painted marks that left the box that owns them.
# `<example>\t<count>`. A RATCHET: the boot gate in `tools/rpc_verify.py` refuses
# a surface that reports more escapes than its row allows, so a number here may
# fall and never rise. Raising one to silence a red is the single use that turns
# Why a count rather than a list of marks: the identity of an escape is a
# rectangle, and rectangles move. Pinning them would report an unrelated layout
# change as a new defect — the same reasoning `docs/text-smear-budget.tsv` gives.
# MEASURED 2026-08-11 over all 223 example packages, at each one's own opening
# size, through the real view -> layout -> shape pipeline:
#   unmeasured                9   (listed below, and NOT counted as clean)
# The nine that could not be measured, and why. Recorded rather than omitted,
# because "did not answer" and "answered zero" are different facts and a file
# that keeps only the second reads as coverage it does not have:
#   ai-introspect-demo      boot timed out on the readiness handshake
#   forge-counter           exits during boot (rc=0) — a codegen fixture, no window
#   hello-audio             no audio device on this host
#   hello-button-tui        the terminal backend has no GPU surface to shape with
# The two biggest rows are worth naming here because they are the analysis tool's
